description: Central Province Provincial Council - Notify the appointments made by the Central Province Provincial Council
reasoning: This gazette contains only government personnel changes (appointments to replace resigned officials) with named individuals (Mr. Ediriweera Weerawardena and Mr. Chinthana Ekanayake) and their basic titles (Chairman of Road Development Authority and Chairman of Passenger Transport Services Authority). It does not include detailed descriptions of portfolio responsibilities or subject matter areas, making it a People Gazette according to the classification rules.
